title: Add unit tests for zones 1-8
body: Marcus Lee wants tests before the storefront relies on this at checkout. Cover single 12 oz bags, single 2 lb bags and mixed orders in every zone.

title: Rates for mixed 12 oz + 2 lb orders look too high
body: Dana Whitfield compared September carrier invoices with our estimates. For orders that mix a 2 lb bag with 12 oz bags, we overestimate by about $1.50 because the weight is rounded up before the first pound is subtracted. Check the rounding in `estimate()`.
